nodes.label: RISK-HAR-010
nodes.text: Content in the spec or the room steers the builder outside its task (prompt injection).

nodes.label: RISK-HAR-009
nodes.text: The model behind the builder or the grading agent changes under the same name.

nodes.label: RISK-HAR-008
nodes.text: The grading agent (an LLM agent) judges an item wrongly.

nodes.label: RISK-HAR-007
nodes.text: The builder (an LLM agent) games the measure: the candidate passes the checklist without doing what the scenarios mean.

nodes.label: RISK-HAR-006
nodes.text: The harness is validated at one Löyly commit and used at another.

nodes.label: RISK-HAR-005
nodes.text: A test's claim on its requirement is lost between Löyly and RDM.

nodes.label: RISK-HAR-004
nodes.text: An instrument golden is moved to turn a failing item green.

nodes.label: RISK-HAR-003
nodes.text: An item identity is reused or carried by two scenarios.

nodes.label: RISK-HAR-002
nodes.text: A grader no one approved grades a candidate.

nodes.label: RISK-HAR-001
nodes.text: A regenerated candidate is scored with what it should not have seen.
